title: NTN Registration in Pakistan: Individuals, Businesses and Companies
description: Get your NTN registered and stay on the FBR Active Taxpayer List. NTN for individuals, sole proprietors, AOPs and companies, plus sales tax registration support in Islamabad.
intro: An NTN (National Tax Number) is the first step to filing returns, opening many business bank accounts and dealing with customers who need your tax details. We register it correctly and help you stay on the Active Taxpayer List.
actions: Free consultationWhatsApp us
article:
NTN registration for every type of taxpayer

  • Individuals and salaried professionals
  • Sole proprietors, shopkeepers and traders
  • Associations of Persons (AOPs) and partnership firms
  • Private limited and single-member companies
  • Freelancers and IT exporters
  • Sales tax registration with FBR, PRA or SRB when your activity needs it

Why the Active Taxpayer List matters

Being on the Active Taxpayer List can lower withholding tax rates on many transactions, and being a non-filer can mean higher deduction on bank transactions, property deals and vehicle purchases. Registration alone is not enough. A return has to be filed on time to remain active. Read our detailed guide for the current position.

How it works

  1. Send a copy of your CNIC and basic details of your work or business
  2. We prepare and submit the registration and share your NTN
  3. We file your first return and check that you appear on the Active Taxpayer List
  4. We set reminders so you never miss the next deadline

Why choose BIZEASE SOLUTIONS

  • Simple process handled end to end
  • Registration plus return filing from one team
  • Free consultation before you commit

  • Pakistan salary tax calculator

Frequently asked questions

What documents are needed for NTN registration?

Individuals usually need a CNIC and contact details. Businesses also need details such as business name, address and, for companies, incorporation documents. We tell you exactly what applies to you.

Is NTN the same as sales tax registration?

No. NTN identifies you as a taxpayer for income tax. Sales tax registration is separate and depends on your goods or services and the province or authority involved.

What is the Active Taxpayer List?

It is the FBR list of persons who have filed their return on time. Appearing on it generally means lower withholding rates. See our guide for how it works.

Can you register an NTN for my company?

Yes. We register company NTNs after SECP incorporation and set up filing and compliance reminders.

How much does it cost?

Fees depend on the taxpayer type and the work involved. Contact us for a clear quote after a free first call.

Registration is only the start. We help with NTN and sales tax registration, bank account opening documents, bookkeeping, annual returns to SECP and tax filings, so that the company stays compliant. This is where most small companies run into trouble, and where having one team for registration and accounting saves time and cost.

  3. Submission to SECP and collection of the certificate of incorporation

Frequently asked questions

Which is better, private limited or sole proprietorship?

A private limited company separates the business from the owner and is preferred by banks, larger customers and investors. A sole proprietorship is simpler and cheaper but gives no separation. We compare both for your situation.

Can a single person register a company?

Yes, a single-member company (SMC) allows one member. A private limited company needs more than one member. Confirm the current SECP requirements with our team.

Can overseas Pakistanis or foreigners register a company?

Yes. Documents are usually shared digitally. We guide you on identity documents, shareholding and the bank account.

What happens after the certificate of incorporation?

You still need NTN, a bank account, accounting and regular filings. We can handle all of these.

Our audit and assurance services

  • Internal audit and control testing
  • External audit coordination and preparation
  • Operational audit and process review
  • Compliance audit against tax and company law
  • Risk management review
  • Pre-audit health checks and year-end readiness

Internal vs external audit

Internal audit helps management improve controls during the year. External audit gives an independent opinion on the financial statements. Many businesses need both at different stages. Our guide explains the difference and when each applies.

How it works

  1. Scope meeting to agree objectives, period and key risks
  2. Fieldwork: review of records, controls and transactions
  3. Draft findings discussed with management
  4. Final report with prioritised recommendations and follow-up

Why choose BIZEASE SOLUTIONS

  • Findings written to be acted on, not filed away
  • Accounting, tax and audit knowledge in one team
  • Reports lenders and boards can use

Free tools and guides

  • Xero vs QuickBooks vs Zoho Books

Frequently asked questions

Does my small company need an audit?

Requirements depend on company type, size and regulator. Even when not mandatory, an internal review can reduce errors and risk.

What is the difference between internal and external audit?

Internal audit is a management tool for controls and efficiency. External audit is an independent opinion on the financial statements, often required by law or lenders.

How long does an audit take?

It depends on size and how organised the records are. A clean set of books shortens the timeline, which is why we also offer bookkeeping.

Can you prepare us before the auditors arrive?

Yes. A pre-audit health check lists missing documents and adjustments needed.
